Short TitlePub. L. 99–570, title VIII, § 8001, Oct. 27, 1986, 100 Stat. 3207–161, provided that title VIII of Pub. L. 99–570, which enacted this chapter, was to be cited as the “President’s Media Commission on Alcohol and Drug Abuse Prevention Act”.
